desc:
⚠️ THIS GAME REQUIRES 2 PLAYERS! ⚠️

Team up with a friend in Carry A Bunny, a 2 player obby where one player becomes the Human and the other becomes the Bunny! 🐰

🤝 Work together through unique 2-player obstacles
🐰 Carry and protect your Bunny
🌎 Make your way through multiple courses
🎨 Unlock Bunny & Hat skins
🎁 Earn rewards just by playing

Carry your Bunny, protect your Bunny, and most importantly... love your Bunny ❤️

✨ NEW UPDATE
🐇 New Bunny Skins
🎩 New Hat Skins
🎁 New Rewards
❤️ More fixes & improvements

Can you and your partner make it through every course?
